◎ (D) specification ambiguity
SPEC:
- Select taus with pT > 20 GeV and |eta| < 2.3
CODE:
- [t for t in get_taus(event) if t['pt'] > 20 and abs(t['eta']) < 2.3]
Reason:
The SPEC does not specify whether the selection should be applied to the broader event-level collection or to a pre-selected collection. The code applies the selection to the taus retrieved by get_taus, which is a plausible interpretation.

〔L256-L257〕

SPEC:
- Select jets with pT > 30 GeV and |eta| < 4.7
CODE:
- [j for j in get_jets(event) if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 4.7]
Reason:
The SPEC does not specify whether the selection should be applied to the broader event-level collection or to a pre-selected collection. The code applies the selection to the jets retrieved by get_jets, which is a plausible interpretation.

〔L262-L263〕

◎ (D) specification ambiguity

Reason:
The SPEC does not specify whether the opposite-sign check should be applied to the selected taus or to a broader collection. The code applies the check to the selected taus, which is a plausible interpretation.
